title: Add service container name annotation
body:
When using `podman kube play`, a service container is created with a name like `ca3ffa05aa62-service`.
This PR adds an annotation so that the name of this container can be overridden, similar to what's
possible for the infra container.

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

```release-note
- Added new annotation `io.podman.annotations.service-container.name` for
  setting the service container name when using `kube play`.
- Fix: `kube play --annotation` is now applied to DaemonSets and Deployments
- Fix: `kube play` now starts service container for sdnotify handling on DaemonSets
```

comments.body: I tested manually, and am investigating the test suite to see if and how an automated test can be created for this, a little guidance would be welcome.

Another question is if a DaemonSet should have a service container or not, and if DaemonSets should apply the `--annotations` flag or not. They didn't before, to me it seems like both those things were missing, so I added them. If that's not desired, those commits are easy to drop.
